name: Kindlop
lore: Its ear tips glow brighter when it is happy. Families leave a lamp out so a Kindlop will stay the winter.
origin: Born in a lamp left burning through a long winter.

name: Smoldrake
lore: It cannot fly and never tries. Its smoke mane tells its mood: grey when calm, white when it means business.
origin: A Kindlop that kept the lighthouse fire for a whole season.

name: Calderox
lore: The cracks in its shoulder plates glow like banked coals. Herders warm their hands on a dozing Calderox in winter.
origin: Said to sleep inside the old kilns of the Thornridge.

name: Puddlet
lore: It is mostly water and a little stubbornness. After storms, dozens bob in the gutters, blowing bubbles at each other.
origin: A drop of the lighthouse lake that never wanted to sink.

name: Riptail
lore: It rides the current backwards just to show it can. Fishers say a Riptail in the weir means a good catch.
origin: Grows in the strong currents below the Saltmarsh dikes.

name: Leviarch
lore: The ring of light above it never touches the water. Old maps mark its lake with a single drawn circle.
origin: Old tales say it carries the lake's light down to the deep.

name: Mossling
lore: It hears rain coming with its long leaf ears and sits very still until the first drop. Gardeners welcome it: wherever it naps, seedlings follow.
origin: Sprouts where a Wayfarer once rested under a fern.

variants.lore: Under the Solenne sun its moss turns golden and smells of hay.

name: Thornback
lore: It rolls into a thorny ball when startled, then forgets why and rolls home.
origin: Its thorns grew to guard the young ferns of the Fernstair.

name: Verdantusk
lore: Ferns grow in its shaggy mane, and birds nest in its beard. An old one can graze for hours without moving a step.
origin: Walks the shaded edge of the forest where moss turns dark.

name: Zippit
lore: It stores static by scuttling across dry grass. Touching one in autumn makes your hair stand on end for an hour.
origin: A spark that jumped off the first storm over Brindlewick.

name: Glimmerax
lore: Its axe-shaped horn lights the way for night travellers. It is drawn to lanterns and to people humming.
origin: A Zippit that caught the lighthouse beam and kept it.

name: Shalebat
lore: Its wings are thin plates of slate that clatter in flight. Colonies sound like rain on a tin roof.
origin: Chipped off the Crowcrest cliffs on a cold night.

name: Obsidroth
lore: Slow, patient and very heavy. The glass shards on its back ring like bells when it laughs.
origin: Its stone hardened deep in the cliff, far from any light.

name: Zephlet
lore: It spreads its kite membrane and lets the wind push it along the ground. It has never once looked where it was going.
origin: A gust that got lost between the hills and stayed.

variants.lore: In Corvane its feathers soak up the rain and it glides low over the canals.

name: Tempestrel
lore: It rides storm winds over the peaks. Its crest crackles before a gale; shepherds watch it to know when to head home.
origin: Rides out every storm on the coast and returns unhurt.

variants.lore: Corvane storms gave it rain-grey wings that shed water like oil.

name: Wickit
lore: The little light on its crest never goes out, even under water. Miners once kept one in each tunnel as a friend.
origin: The last flicker of a candle that a child would not blow out.

variants.lore: Near the Ashmere furnaces its little flame burns orange instead of white.

name: Lumenewt
lore: Its gill stalks glow in slow waves, like breathing. Children follow the lights along the riverbank at dusk.
origin: Found where lamp light falls on still water.

variants.lore: It glows like a lamp in a glassworks and its skin feels warm as fresh glass.

name: Mirkmole
lore: It wears a hood of shadow against the sun. It is not afraid of the dark, only of being disturbed.
origin: Dug its way up from the dark under Murk Hollow.

name: Duskdigger
lore: It carries a slab of basalt on its back like a roof. Abandoned mines are often its doing, dug in a single night.
origin: Only a Mirkmole that saw Murk Hollow's dark grows like this.

name: Kelpup
lore: Its kelp fronds grow back when trimmed, so it loves a haircut. It barks at waves it doesn't like.
origin: Washed up in a knot of kelp after a high tide.

name: Kelphound
lore: Its mane streams out behind it when it swims, hiding it from bigger hunters. It guards fishing boats it has decided are its own.
origin: A Kelpup that found a pearl and grew around its glow.

name: Blotling
lore: It copies any line it sees onto the nearest wall. Wipe it off and the Blotling looks hurt.
origin: Crawled out of Mirela's old inkwells in the lighthouse.

name: Scrivane
lore: It draws maps of places it has never been. Wayfarers who followed them say the roads were right.
origin: A Blotling that read every page of Mirela's map book.

name: Hushkin
lore: It has no voice at all. When it is glad, the sign on its brow glows a little brighter.
origin: Born from the Hush itself, the silence that fell over Veydal.

name: Silentra
habitat: Ruins at the edge of Rifts
lore: It speaks only in floating signs of light. Those who learn to read them never feel alone again.
origin: A Hushkin that heard ten perfect echoes and answered in light.

name: Paddlewisp
lore: On stormy nights it pushes small boats gently back to the jetty, then spins away before anyone can thank it.
origin: Lives under Aldo's ferry and was born in its wake.

name: Ferrowyn
lore: Its sails catch every gust. Ferry crews leave a seat free at the bow in case it wants to ride along.
origin: A Paddlewisp that guided a ferry through a whole storm season.

name: Talusk
lore: If you trip over a Talusk it rolls together again and blinks at you, a little offended.
origin: A heap of Crowcrest scree that woke up with one grey eye.

variants.lore: Salt crystals grow on its tusks after a season by the Solenne lakes.

name: Talusgard
lore: It stacks one path stone on its back for every lost Wayfarer it has led home.
origin: A Talusk that carried its first waymark up the Crowcrest.

name: Cairnhold
lore: A beacon fire burns on its top stone. On dark nights it climbs the ridge so travellers can find the way.
origin: The oldest waymark of the Crowcrest, still walking.

name: Fluting
lore: The wind plays it like a flute. Lost walkers who follow the tune end up on the path home.
origin: A hollow reed of the Saltmarsh that learned the wind's songs.

name: Marshfife
lore: At dusk its song carries across the whole marsh, and the reeds bend toward it to listen.
origin: A Fluting that played through one long Saltmarsh dusk.

name: Glasstarn
lore: It only shows itself when there is no wind at all. Then it holds the whole sky on its back.
origin: A piece of a Crowcrest mountain lake that mirrors the sky.

name: Lanternel
lore: It follows the lighthouse beam as it sweeps the coast. Since the first storm it has never left Brindlewick.
origin: Followed the lighthouse lights to Brindlewick on the first storm night.

name: Seamlet
lore: It tries to sew the Rifts shut with threads of light. The threads never hold, so it keeps trying.
origin: A spark that jumped from the edge of a Rift.

name: Mendlace
lore: Where a Rift was mended, a Mendlace stays behind and checks the seam every night.
origin: A Seamlet that saw its own Rift mended at last.

name: Croziel
lore: It sleeps rolled up tight. In spring a whole slope of them uncurls at once.
origin: A young fern frond of the Fernstair that never stopped curling.

name: Frondmere
lore: Its antlers are open fern fronds. Each year it unrolls a new one.
origin: A Croziel that finally unrolled, frond by frond.

name: Brinelet
lore: Rain makes it shrink and sulk. A dry summer makes it grow almost a hand taller.
origin: A salt crystal from the pans of the Saltmarsh.

name: Saltspire
lore: After a dry summer it stands like a white pillar on the flats. Sailors use it to steer by.
origin: A Brinelet that grew through three dry summers.

name: Millwhit
lore: It rides the turning sails of old mills and squeaks once for every turn.
origin: Blown off a mill sail during the first spring storm of Corvane.

name: Millvane
lore: Its wings turn like sails. Millers say a good harvest follows it.
origin: A Millwhit that kept a broken mill turning through a whole rainy season.

name: Drizzlet
lore: It sleeps in rain barrels and wakes when the first drop falls.
origin: Fell from a raincloud that drifted too low over the delta.

name: Rainmantle
lore: Where it walks, a soft rain follows and the fields turn green.
origin: A Drizzlet that listened to the rain for a hundred nights.

name: Reedquill
lore: It writes little marks in the mud with its quill-like reed.
origin: Sprouted from a reed pen that a river clerk dropped.

name: Reedwarden
lore: It guards the river banks and mends broken dikes with reeds.
origin: A Reedquill that grew tall in the oldest reed bed of Corvane.

name: Cogmite
lore: It hums inside gear boxes and keeps the cogs from slipping.
origin: Found humming inside the oldest gear box of a river mill.

name: Cogwright
lore: It builds little wheels out of pebbles and sets them spinning.
origin: A Cogmite that learned every gear in a mill by heart.

name: Puddock
lore: It sits in puddles for hours and croaks when the water rises.
origin: Hatched in a flood field after the river broke its banks.

name: Delthorn
lore: Its back grows spines of river stone. It sleeps where three streams meet.
origin: A Puddock that sat out a whole flood on a single stone.

name: Glimmoth
lore: It circles the quay lamps and leaves a faint glow on everything it touches.
origin: Drawn out of the dark by the first lamp lit on the Corvane quays.

name: Wickmoth
lore: Its wings carry tiny lights. Boatmen follow it home in fog.
origin: A Glimmoth that guided a lost boat home through the fog.

name: Silthop
lore: It hops across silt banks and never sinks, however soft the mud.
origin: Shaped from river silt when the delta was still young.

name: Siltgrove
lore: Small trees grow on its back. Birds nest there in spring.
origin: A Silthop that slept so long on an island that it took root.

name: Flourie
lore: It puffs out clouds of flour dust and giggles when someone sneezes.
origin: Rose from a sack of flour on the day the first mill of Corvane opened.

name: Floursprite
lore: It drifts over the fields at harvest and shines like the morning.
origin: A Flourie that danced through a whole harvest festival.

name: Cindle
lore: It naps by the furnace doors and glows brighter when glass is blown.
origin: Born from a spark that leapt out of the first glass furnace of Ashmere.

name: Glassfell
lore: Its fur turns to warm glass at the tips and rings like a bell.
origin: A Cindle that slept inside a cooling glass furnace.

name: Etchling
lore: It scratches fine lines into copper and ink pools in its tracks.
origin: Scratched itself out of an old copperplate nobody could read.

name: Burinox
lore: Its horn is a sharp engraver's tool. It draws maps of places it has never seen.
origin: An Etchling that copied every plate in an Ashmere workshop.

name: Ashwren
lore: It bathes in warm ash and shakes it off in little grey clouds.
origin: Flew out of a chimney the night the moor fires went out.

name: Ashcrest
lore: Its crest glows like embers. It sings only when the moor is quiet.
origin: An Ashwren that sang until the ash moor grew green again.

name: Bogwick
lore: A small light flickers on its head. Travellers follow it and find dry paths.
origin: Grew from a peat lamp left burning at the edge of the bog.

name: Fenwarden
lore: It walks the bog at night and keeps the peat from burning.
origin: A Bogwick that guarded the bog through a long dry summer.

name: Cullet
lore: It is made of broken glass pieces that click softly when it walks.
origin: Gathered itself from the scrap heap behind a glassworks.

name: Cullhorn
lore: Its glass horn catches the sun and throws rainbows on the moor.
origin: A Cullet that was mended with gold by a kind glassmaker.

name: Smeltpup
lore: It chews on slag and its breath smells like hot metal.
origin: Pulled from a slag heap still warm from the smelter.

name: Smeltmaw
lore: Its jaw glows red. It melts rocks just by breathing on them.
origin: A Smeltpup that sat by the smelter fire for a whole winter.

name: Solkit
lore: It turns its face to the sun all day and glows softly at night.
origin: Woke in the first light that touched the Solenne plateau.

name: Solmantle
lore: Its mane holds sunlight. Shepherds warm their hands on it.
origin: A Solkit that watched a hundred sunrises from the highest stone.

name: Saltsprig
lore: Salt crystals grow on its leaves and sparkle in the sun.
origin: Sprouted where the salt lake dried for a single summer.

name: Saltcrown
lore: A crown of salt crystals rings its head. It hums by the lake at noon.
origin: A Saltsprig that drank from every salt lake of Solenne.

name: Orrlet
lore: Little rings orbit its body. It follows the stars across the dome.
origin: Fell out of a star map in the oldest observatory of Solenne.

name: Orrerine
lore: Its rings spin like a model of the sky. Astronomers set clocks by it.
origin: An Orrlet that counted every star in the plateau sky.

name: Duneshrew
lore: It burrows into hot sand and pops up far away.
origin: Dug its way up from under the oldest dune of the plateau.

name: Dunebastion
lore: Its shell is a dune of hard sand. Winds break on it like waves.
origin: A Duneshrew that held still through a whole sand storm.

name: Shimmerlet
habitat: Heat haze over the salt flats
lore: It hides in the shimmer of hot air. Only its shadow shows where it is.
origin: Rose out of the heat haze over the salt flats one bright noon.

name: Mirassil
habitat: Heat haze over the salt flats
lore: It shows travellers lakes that are not there, then leads them to real water.
origin: A Shimmerlet that led a lost caravan to water.

name: Highhare
lore: It leaps from ridge to ridge and lands without a sound.
origin: Born on the windiest ridge of the Solenne plateau.

name: Zenithare
lore: It runs so high on the ridges that it seems to touch the sky.
origin: A Highhare that raced the sunset along every ridge.

name: Velahra
habitat: Under the lake before the lighthouse
lore: The First Voice of Veydal. It sleeps as a light under the lake and sang the land together long ago. It was the last to see Mirela.
origin: One of the six First Voices, whose silence let the Hush fall over the land.

name: Hallowmur
habitat: The broken belfry of the Bellstone Ruins
lore: A bell that learned to listen. When the last ringer of the Bellstone left, the bell kept tolling by itself until it woke as Hallowmur.
origin: Woke from the last toll of the Bellstone bell.

name: Scriptorax
habitat: Between the shelves of the Wren Library, after closing
lore: Its wings are quills and its blood is ink. It writes down every route a Wayfarer walks, and crosses out the ones that were lies.
origin: Grew from the ink of the first map of Veydal.

name: Lumivane
habitat: The sunlit crown of the Sun Rift, once it is sealed
lore: A deer with a halo of horn and a lantern where its heart should be. Travellers lost in the dunes follow its glow home.
origin: Its heart was a lantern left at the Sun Rift by the first Wayfarer of Solenne.

name: Zephyrel
habitat: The wind above the Wide Rift's edge
lore: Four wings, no rest. It rides the updraft of the Wide Rift like a kite on a string nobody holds, and it has never touched the ground.
origin: A kite string snapped over the Wide Rift, and the wind kept the kite.

name: Monolurk
habitat: The cooled heart of the Kiln Rift
lore: A standing stone carved with runes nobody can read. When the Kiln Rift was sealed, the stone stood up and looked around.
origin: A rune stone from before the Rifts, baked hard in the Kiln Rift's heat.

name: Vorlucent
habitat: The dark beam of the Shade Rift, once it is sealed
lore: Its wings carry two eclipses. Where it lands, noon turns to dusk for a moment, and every lamp nearby flickers to greet it.
origin: Born in the shadow the Shade Rift cast at noon.

name: Rollib
lore: It rolls a ball of warm sand all day and sleeps curled around it at night.
origin: Hatched from a grain of sand that held the sun for a whole year.

name: Rollibex
lore: Its ball now glows at dusk. Travellers follow it to the next well.
origin: A Rollib that rolled its ball across the whole plateau and back.

name: Helirollax
lore: The ball on its back burns like a small sun. It pushes the morning over the dunes.
origin: The old towers say it rolled the first dawn up the sky.

name: Sirocub
lore: Its big ears catch the smallest breeze. It naps where the wind is coolest.
origin: Born in the first warm wind of a Solenne spring.

name: Sirocat
lore: It runs along dune crests so fast that the sand sings behind it.
origin: A Sirocub that raced a sandstorm and won.

name: Siroclaw
lore: When it flicks its ears, the hot wind turns. Caravans wait for its call.
origin: Grown in the eye of the great summer wind.

name: Scaldasp
lore: It basks on stones until it is too hot to touch, then hides in the shade.
origin: Slipped out of a crack in a sun-scorched rock.

name: Scaldcoil
lore: Its coils keep the noon heat long after sunset. Lizards sleep against it.
origin: A Scaldasp that slept a whole summer on the hottest rock.

name: Scaldrahn
lore: Heat shimmers above its horns. It guards the road between the oases.
origin: Grown where the sand road crosses the old lava field.

name: Noonpip
lore: It sings only at noon, when the shadows are shortest.
origin: Hatched on the top step of a sun tower.

name: Noonwhist
lore: A ring of light glows behind its head. Tower keepers use it as a clock.
origin: A Noonpip that sang through a hundred noons.

name: Noonsoral
lore: Its crest flares like the sun at its height. Its song carries across the plateau.
origin: The tower keepers say it is the noon itself, given feathers.

name: Spinnub
lore: It stores water in its round body and shares it with thirsty travellers.
origin: Sprouted from a seed buried under a waymarker stone.

name: Spinnarow
lore: A crown of blossoms opens on its head after the rare rain.
origin: A Spinnub that waited seven years for one rain.

name: Spinnacle
lore: It stands still for weeks like a stone tower. Birds nest safely among its spines.
origin: Grown on the highest slope of the cactus gardens.

name: Wadlet
lore: It sleeps in damp sand and wakes when a well fills up.
origin: Found in a dry riverbed after the first flood in years.

name: Wadishell
lore: Salt crystals grow on its shell. It carries water to dry pools.
origin: A Wadlet that crossed a salt flat to find a new pool.

name: Wadibastion
lore: Its shell is wide as a well cover. An oasis forms wherever it rests.
origin: The well diggers say the first oasis grew around one.

name: Ergfin
lore: It swims through loose sand as if it were water.
origin: Hatched in a dune that was once a lake.

name: Ergskim
lore: Its fins cut the sand so fast that it leaves a wake of dust.
origin: An Ergfin that swam the whole sand sea in one night.

name: Ergrava
lore: Whole dunes shift when it turns. Sailors of the sand sea greet it with a bell.
origin: Grown in the deep sand where the old lake bed lies.

name: Ardlet
lore: A small flame dances on its head. It keeps tower hearths warm at night.
origin: Sparked from the last ember of a tower beacon.

name: Ardlume
lore: Its flame turns white when it is proud. It hums while it warms the stones.
origin: An Ardlet that kept a beacon burning through a sandstorm.

name: Ardenthal
lore: Its crown of fire lights a whole tower. Wayfarers see it from a day away.
origin: Grown at the top of the oldest sun tower.

name: Fulgrit
lore: It licks the glassy sand where lightning struck and crackles happily.
origin: Born where a dry storm struck a dune.

name: Fulgorin
lore: The horn on its head draws sparks out of the dry air.
origin: A Fulgrit that stood in a storm and caught three bolts.

name: Fulgorath
lore: Its spines are tubes of lightning glass. When it roars, the sky answers.
origin: Grown on the glass fields after the great dry storm.

name: Carabun
lore: It walks beside caravans and never gets lost. Its hump holds water.
origin: Found asleep at a caravan stop, as if it had always been there.

name: Caravant
lore: It can walk ten days without a drink. Children play in the shade of its hump.
origin: A Carabun that led a lost caravan home.

name: Caravault
lore: Its hump holds a whole well. Towns grow along the roads it walks.
origin: The caravan folk say it walked the first road across Solenne.

name: Velvit
lore: It wakes at dusk and flutters around lamps until dawn.
origin: Hatched from a cocoon spun in a lamp shade.

name: Velvessa
lore: The eyes on its wings stare back at night hunters.
origin: A Velvit that stayed by one lamp for a whole season.

name: Velverain
lore: Its wings are soft as velvet and dark as the desert sky. Dust from them makes people dream.
origin: Grown under the starless sky of a new moon.

name: Clasplet
lore: It hides under stones in the heat and comes out to hunt beetles at night.
origin: Crawled out from under a fallen tower stone.

name: Claspirant
lore: It raises its tail as a warning long before it strikes.
origin: A Clasplet that guarded one stone for a hundred nights.

name: Claspreign
lore: Its claws can crack tower stone. Even sandstorms go around its den.
origin: Grown in the dark under the oldest ruin of Solenne.

name: Obelit
lore: It stands still on tower steps and is often taken for a small statue.
origin: Chipped off a sun tower when the first stone was laid.

name: Obelith
lore: The marks on its body glow in the order of the stars.
origin: An Obelit that stood one whole year in the sun.

name: Obelordan
lore: Its spire points at the sun all day. Its shadow tells the hour.
origin: The tower builders say they copied its shape.

name: Haboblet
lore: It curls up in dust devils and spins with them for fun.
origin: Whirled up out of a small dust devil.

name: Haboborn
lore: The sail on its back catches the storm. It rides the front of every sandstorm.
origin: A Haboblet that flew inside a storm for three days.

name: Habobrax
lore: When it raises its sail, a wall of sand rises behind it.
origin: Grown in the heart of the great sandstorm of the Tower Rift.

name: Stiltwade
lore: It stands on one leg in the salt shallows and never seems to tire.
origin: Hatched on a salt island in the middle of the lake.

name: Stiltregent
lore: Its long fan tail opens like a sunrise over the lake.
origin: A Stiltwade that led a flock across the salt lake.

name: Palmop
lore: Its leaves give shade to anything smaller than itself.
origin: Sprouted from a date stone dropped by a traveller.

name: Palmonarch
lore: Its fronds glow at dawn. Whole villages rest in its shade at noon.
origin: A Palmop that grew at the first well of Ochrewell.

name: Bakedil
lore: It sleeps in clay ovens after the bread is out. Its shell stays warm all night.
origin: Found in a cooling oven, curled up like a loaf.

name: Bakedillon
lore: The plates on its back are hot as baking stones. Bakers ask it for help.
origin: A Bakedil that warmed a whole village through a cold night.

name: Hazejel
lore: It floats in the noon haze and is hard to see unless you blink.
origin: Drifted out of a mirage that did not fade.

name: Hazejellith
lore: It shows travellers false lakes, then leads them to a real one.
origin: A Hazejel that drifted over the whole sand sea.

name: Corocub
lore: Its mane glows like embers. It pounces on its own shadow.
origin: Born on the hottest rock of the plateau at noon.

name: Coronarch
lore: Its mane blazes like the sun's corona. Its roar can be heard across the plateau.
origin: A Corocub that stared at the sun without blinking.

name: Chirrik
lore: It chirps in the dry grass from dawn to dusk.
origin: Hatched in a millet field after a hot summer.

name: Chirrikade
lore: One leap carries it over a house. Farmers welcome it, it eats only weeds.
origin: A Chirrik that jumped across a whole canyon.

name: Brinewhorl
lore: Its shell is crusted with salt. It writes slow spirals on the lake shore.
origin: Grew from a salt crystal that was never washed away.

name: Gyrevult
lore: It circles high over the canyon for hours without a single wing beat.
origin: Rose out of the canyon on the first thermal of the morning.

name: Heliodrop
lore: A drop of sunlight that fell and did not cool. It giggles when touched.
origin: Fell from the sky on the longest day of the year.

name: Duskmirrah
lore: It is seen only in the moment the sun sets. Half of it glows, half is shadow.
origin: Stepped out of the line between day and night.

name: Sootpaw
lore: It leaves black paw prints on every roof it crosses.
origin: Tumbled out of a chimney during the first winter fire.

name: Sootlurk
lore: It hides in ash heaps with only its glowing eyes showing.
origin: A Sootpaw that slept a whole winter in a cold chimney.

name: Sootharrow
lore: Its tail burns like a torch. Chimney sweeps tip their hats to it.
origin: Grown on the tallest chimney of Cinderfold.

name: Vitrill
lore: Its shell is clear glass. You can see its little heart glow inside.
origin: Formed from a drop of glass that fell from a blowpipe.

name: Vitrillon
lore: Glass crystals grow on its back. It rings like a bell when it bumps into things.
origin: A Vitrill that rested in a cooling oven for a night.

name: Vitrillaxe
lore: Its glass horn splits light into colours. The glassworks hang its shed shards in their windows.
origin: Grown in the oldest furnace of the glassworks.

name: Sablet
habitat: Dark rafters of the engravers' halls
lore: It watches the engravers at work and blinks slowly when they make a mistake.
origin: Hatched in the rafters of the engravers' hall.

name: Sablowl
habitat: Dark rafters of the engravers' halls
lore: Its feathers are soft as soot. It flies without a sound through the dark halls.
origin: A Sablet that stayed awake through a hundred night shifts.

name: Sablarch
habitat: Dark rafters of the engravers' halls
lore: Its wide eyes see every line in the dark. Engravers ask it to check their plates.
origin: Grown in the darkest corner of the Gravers' Hall.

name: Quenchet
lore: It hisses when it slides into water and leaves a trail of steam.
origin: Slipped out of a quench tank when hot iron was dipped in.

name: Quenchcoil
lore: Its fin sail cools in water and glows again in the air.
origin: A Quenchet that swam through every quench tank of the works.

name: Quenchwyrm
lore: Clouds of steam roll off its back. Smiths use its pools to harden their best blades.
origin: Grown in the great steaming pool under the kilns.

name: Brickit
lore: It stacks loose bricks into little towers and sits on top of them.
origin: Pressed into shape by mistake in a brick mould.

name: Brickwarden
lore: It patches kiln walls with its own warm clay.
origin: A Brickit that guarded a kiln through a whole firing.

name: Brickolossus
lore: A fire burns on its shoulders like a kiln. Whole streets are built from its old bricks.
origin: The brickmakers say it carried the first kiln to Ashmere.

name: Clinklet
lore: It clinks when it walks. It eats the cool slag nobody wants.
origin: Crawled out of a slag heap that had cooled for a year.

name: Clinkshell
lore: Sharp slag spikes grow on its shell. Miners leave it alone.
origin: A Clinklet that ate its way through a whole slag heap.

name: Clinkerdome
lore: Its shell is a heap of black glass. When it sleeps it looks like a hill.
origin: Grown on the largest slag heap of Ashmere.

name: Peatlet
lore: It sinks into the bog up to its eyes and waits for rain.
origin: Sprouted from a peat brick left out in the rain.

name: Peatbloom
lore: A ring of pale petals opens around its head when the fen is quiet.
origin: A Peatlet that drank from the black water for a whole season.

name: Peatmonarch
lore: Its petals glow over the dark fen. Lost walkers follow the light home.
origin: Grown in the oldest bog, where the peat is deepest.

name: Gloomgill
lore: It swims in black water and lights its way with its feelers.
origin: Hatched in fen water too dark for the sun to reach.

name: Gloomgillar
lore: Its spines prick anything that reaches into the water.
origin: A Gloomgill that hid in the fen through a long drought.

name: Gloomgillith
lore: Its lights draw small fish close. Fen folk say not to follow them.
origin: Grown in the deepest pool of the dark fen.

name: Fumelet
lore: A curl of smoke with sleepy eyes. It drifts wherever the wind pushes it.
origin: Rose from a chimney on a windless night.

name: Fumewraith
lore: It wraps itself around lamps and dims them to sleep in the dark.
origin: A Fumelet that drifted through every chimney of the works.

name: Fumeregent
lore: A crown of smoke rises from its head. Where it rests, the air turns grey and calm.
origin: Grown in the smoke cloud over the great kilns.

name: Lodekit
lore: It sniffs out ore veins and taps on the rock where miners should dig.
origin: Found in a mine cart, asleep on a pile of ore.

name: Lodebrock
lore: Sparks crackle along its plates when it finds a rich vein.
origin: A Lodekit that found the richest vein in the mine.

name: Lodemarshal
lore: Its tail strikes the rock like a hammer. Whole mines follow its lead.
origin: Grown in the deepest shaft of the Shatterfloor mine.

name: Glowflit
lore: It dances around forge sparks and catches them on its wings.
origin: Hatched from a spark that did not go out.

name: Glowflitter
lore: Its wings glow orange at night. Smiths leave the forge door open for it.
origin: A Glowflit that danced around one forge all winter.

name: Glowflare
lore: When it opens its wings, the night sky over the works lights up like dawn.
origin: Grown in the shower of sparks from the great hammer.

name: Stylet
lore: Its horn is sharp as an engraving needle. It scratches tiny pictures on stones.
origin: Scratched itself out of a spoiled copper plate.

name: Stylox
lore: A spark jumps from its tail tip when it is cross.
origin: A Stylet that engraved a whole wall in one night.

name: Stylaxon
lore: It engraves warnings on cave walls. Only the engravers can read them.
origin: Grown among the lost plates of the old engravers.

name: Coalkid
lore: It nibbles coal and its breath smells of smoke.
origin: Born on a coal ridge in a cold spring.

name: Coalbuck
lore: Its horns glow red at the tips when it charges.
origin: A Coalkid that climbed every coal ridge of Ashmere.

name: Coalpatriarch
lore: Its back holds glowing coal crystals. Herds of Coalkid follow it through the snow.
origin: Grown on the highest ridge, where the coal meets the sky.

name: Glazel
lore: It slides along cooling glass and leaves it smooth and shiny.
origin: Slipped out of a furnace mouth with the first molten glass.

name: Glazelisk
lore: Glass crystals grow along its spine and catch the furnace light.
origin: A Glazel that slept curled around a glass bowl.

name: Glazeldrake
lore: Its body glows like glass just out of the fire. It shapes glass with its breath.
origin: The glassblowers say it taught them their craft.

name: Puffbellow
lore: It puffs up its chest like a bellows and blows the forge fire bright.
origin: Hatched beside a forge bellows on a cold morning.

name: Bellowroc
lore: One beat of its wings stokes a whole furnace. Its crest crackles with sparks.
origin: A Puffbellow that kept the great forge burning through a storm.

name: Lampick
lore: A small light shines above its head. Miners follow it out of the dark.
origin: Lit from a miner's lamp that was left in a tunnel.

name: Lampickard
lore: Its lamp is bright as daylight. It knows every tunnel of the mines.
origin: A Lampick that led a whole shift out of a collapsed tunnel.

name: Charsprout
lore: It sprouts on burnt ground and is the first green after a fire.
origin: Grew from the ashes of a burnt-down barn.

name: Charsylvan
lore: Flames flicker in its leaves but never burn them. Forests regrow around it.
origin: A Charsprout that grew through three fires.

name: Ingotlet
lore: It rolls around in warm ingots and comes out shiny.
origin: Found asleep in a mould between two ingots.

name: Ingotusk
lore: Its tusks are cast metal. It guards the smelter yard at night.
origin: An Ingotlet that slept a whole year in the smelter.

name: Mortarant
lore: It fills cracks in old walls with a paste it makes itself.
origin: Crawled out of a crack in the oldest wall of Ashmere.

name: Mortarmarch
lore: It marches along the walls at night and checks every stone.
origin: A Mortarant that mended a whole town wall.

name: Vaporel
lore: It floats in warm springs and blows steam bubbles.
origin: Bubbled up from a warm spring by the works.

name: Vaporelle
lore: Its fins fan steam over cold workers. Everyone wants it near in winter.
origin: A Vaporel that warmed a frozen spring back to life.

name: Shadeback
lore: Its shell holds the dark of the Shade Rift. Light seems to sink into it.
origin: Crawled out of the Shade Rift when it first opened.

name: Kilnstork
lore: It stands in quench pools and strikes at sparks as if they were fish.
origin: Landed in a quench pool on the night the kilns were first lit.

name: Puffglass
lore: It blows glass bubbles from its mouth and laughs when they pop.
origin: Breathed into shape by a glassblower on a happy day.

name: Flueling
lore: It crackles inside chimney flues and pops out covered in sparks.
origin: Struck to life when lightning hit a chimney.

name: Vesk
habitat: Windy rooftops of the print quarter
lore: It steals proof sheets off the drying lines and brings them back when nobody is looking. Mostly.
origin: Born in a gust that blew a forger's whole print run into the river.

name: Veskara
habitat: Windy rooftops of the print quarter
lore: Its tails sweep chalk lines off the street, so no one can prove where it has been.
origin: A Vesk that outran three print houses and the watch in one night.

name: Veskarion
habitat: Windy rooftops of the print quarter
lore: Three tails, three alibis. The print houses pay it to be seen somewhere else.
origin: The engravers say it was the wind that signed the first false contract.

name: Siltby
habitat: Silted canals under the engravers' bridges
lore: It filters the canal mud and spits out lost rings. It keeps the gold ones.
origin: Hatched in the silt where an engraver dropped his best plate.

name: Siltarra
habitat: Silted canals under the engravers' bridges
lore: Its fins rise like a row of knives when a boat comes too close to its lock.
origin: A Siltby that grew fat on the coins thrown off the bridges for luck.

name: Siltaroth
habitat: Silted canals under the engravers' bridges
lore: It sleeps under the oldest bridge. Some say the bridge is the part of it that shows.
origin: The canal guild swears it was here before the canals were dug.

name: Cindrik
lore: It warms the acid vats with its belly and asks for nothing. That is what worries people.
origin: Hatched from an ember that fell into a bath of etching acid and did not go out.

name: Cindrel
lore: Its crest flares gold when it lies. It has learned to keep its head down.
origin: A Cindrik that kept a chimney burning through a strike and was paid by both sides.

name: Cindravax
lore: One wingbeat dries a whole print run. Forgers bid for its company like it is a seat in court.
origin: The acid works were built around the nest of the first one, and it never forgave them.

name: Nibbet
lore: Every quill on its back is a pen nib. It signs things in its sleep, never its own name.
origin: Curled up from a box of nibs a forger buried when the watch knocked.

name: Nibquill
lore: It scratches perfect copies of any signature into copper. Banks hire it, then lock it up.
origin: A Nibbet that copied the mayor's hand so well the mayor asked it for advice.

name: Nibravure
lore: Its quills hold enough ink to rewrite a city's records overnight. It has done it twice.
origin: The print houses agree on nothing, except that nobody owns a Nibravure. It owns you.

name: Filigrin
lore: It lands on fresh prints and leaves lace patterns that no forger can copy. Forgers hate it.
origin: Hatched under a reading lamp in a room where someone checked banknotes all night.

name: Filigrace
lore: The spots on its wings look like eyes. Witnesses swear it was watching. Courts accept that now.
origin: A Filigrin that slept inside a ledger for a year and woke up knowing every debt.

name: Filigravure
lore: Its wings are etched finer than any banknote. It sells its own dust to the highest bidder.
origin: The old engravers say it flew out of the first plate ever bitten by acid.
